scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p packages/schema/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test: vitest run src packages/schema/tests packages/db/tests/curated.test.ts apps/api/tests
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run data:import
scripts.verify: npm run data:validate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run build
